description: This PHP trait defines properties and methods for handling date range filtering parameters, specifically 'from' and 'to' date values, likely used in data transfer objects within the Leave module of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait that provides date range filtering parameters with getter and setter methods for 'fromDate' and 'toDate'.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date of the date range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date of the date range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date of the date range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date of the date range.
